checks.check: Single-cell mining uses the existing designation
Progress changes while the active rock still blocks movement
Strike events are emitted on actual work cadence
PAUSE does not advance work or emit sound/particle events
Interruption preserves rock damage
Snapshot retains mining progress and work identity
Only the mined cell disappears, neighbouring rock remains
Collision/path/terrain re-evaluate the removed cell
Mining creates eight real stones on site without supplying shared building stock
Explicit collection transports stone to a stockpile
Rectangle felling designates each tree once
Felling uses the existing plant/gather work category
Other priority cannot run a disabled plant/gather job
Plant/gather priority makes the resident approach and chop
Range forbid suspends felling, retains progress
Allow does not duplicate orders
Allow resumes the same work without creating an extra designation
Cancel removes the order and keeps the tree and damage
Campaign save preserves the same damaged tree without regeneration
Both trees finish individually and leave exactly sixteen physical wood
Felled cell loses tree collision; dropped wood remains a normal building obstacle
Presentation events are bounded and completion is emitted once per tree
Twelve simultaneous workers finish distinct cells with exact resource totals
Simultaneous workers retain bounded event history without hidden work queues
Mining and chopping use distinct non-silent PCM sounds
Simultaneous workers share a bounded sound rate
Offscreen/distant work is quiet while nearby work remains audible
One hundred burst cues cannot create an audio pile-up
